style.description:
Additional style information for certain block kinds.  For example, CODE blocks may have the programming language
for pretty printing.

spans.description: The spans within the simple block.

blocks.description: The sub-blocks within the compound block.

cols.description: The desired number of columns, space permitting.

href.description: The target that the whole card links to.

title.description: The title from between the opening brackets. This doesn't appear in the card body.

name.description: The name associated with the sequence of cards (the "cardset").

title:
A card block, which contains a title and a body and is displayed in a bordered recangle arranged in a grid layout.

```md
[[[ Ace ]]]
The **Ace** is the highest and/or lowest card in the pack.
[[[ King ]]]
The **King** is the highest card except for the ace.
[[[ ]]]
```

@see MarkdownCard
